_comment: ADVISORY reference describing the URScript host program and workcell. The AUTHORITATIVE runtime constants (register map, command ids, states, error codes, capabilities) live in robot/protocol.py and are consumed by robot/ur10e_middleware_local_mode.py. This file is NOT read to enforce any safety limit. Anything here that is not enforced by code is marked advisory_* so operators are not misled.

advisory_host._note: Actual connect target comes from trusted env (UR10E_IP) + allowlist (UR10E_ALLOWED_IPS), never from this file or a browser value.

rtde_registers._note: Canonical; mirrors robot/protocol.py. Inputs 18-29, outputs 12-17 (low range required by ur_rtde).

advisory_host_program_notes._note: These demo host programs implement massage modes + arm/stop/pause/resume/ACK/over-force only. They do NOT implement calibration, jog or heartbeat, and always pin OUT_CAL_STATUS=0. The backend therefore hides calibration/jog under the DEMO capability profile. Motion-limit/heartbeat values below were NEVER enforced in software and have been removed to avoid false safety assurance; enforce them on the robot (PolyScope limits + a robot-side watchdog) — see docs/robot/rtde-protocol.md.
